headline.text: Jun 2026: Gross revenue ₹59.30 L (+1.6% vs prior month); Loans disbursed 1,293 (-2.1% vs prior month); Collection efficiency remains below target at 93.9%.

highlights.text: Week of 22 Jun: Loans disbursed 317 (+7.1% week on week); Disbursed amount ₹1.41 Cr (+4.7% week on week); EMI collections ₹1.38 Cr (+16.6% week on week); Payment failure rate 11.2% (+0.8 pp week on week).
Disbursed amount ₹5.86 Cr (+1.3% vs prior month); Net revenue ₹33.96 L (-17.2% vs prior month).
KYC completion (7-day) 62.3% (-0.9 pp vs prior month); Approval rate 62.2% (-2.4 pp vs prior month).
PAR30 3.6% (-0.2 pp vs prior month); NPA (90+ DPD) 2.0% (-0.5 pp vs prior month).
Monthly active users 14,918 (+1.4% vs prior month); Repeat-loan share 34.9% (-3.7 pp vs prior month).

Onboarding redesign experiment: 7-day KYC completion 61.78% treatment vs 58.51% control, difference +3.26 pp (95% CI +0.54 to +5.99 pp), relative uplift +5.6%, p-value 0.0191; P(treatment better) 99.0%.

anomalies.text: No anomaly episodes in the last 8 weeks; the monitor remains active.

Past incident for context: EMI payment failure rate spiked to 47.1% on 15 Aug 2025 (expected 8.9%, robust z 15.6); main driver: failure reason (excess failed debits) = gateway_timeout (96% of the deviation). Window 2025-08-14 to 2025-08-15, 2 day(s) flagged, severity high (no known business event - investigate).

Past incident for context: Signups spiked to 222 on 15 Sep 2025 (expected 113, robust z 6.8); main driver: acquisition channel = affiliate (87% of the deviation). Window 2025-09-08 to 2025-09-21, 14 day(s) flagged, severity high (no known business event - investigate).

Past incident for context: Daily active users spiked to 920 on 16 Sep 2025 (expected 692, robust z 5.8); main driver: platform = android (94% of the deviation). Window 2025-09-13 to 2025-09-20, 6 day(s) flagged, severity high (no known business event - investigate).

experiments.text: EXP-ONB-2026-01 guardrails: approval rate +3.13 pp (pass), FPD30 -1.48 pp (pass), KYC support tickets +0.16 pp (inconclusive). Decision: SHIP with post-launch monitoring of kyc_support_ticket_rate.
EXP-RPY-2025-11 (Autopay nudge at disbursal): autopay 64.28% treatment vs 46.62% control, difference +17.65 pp (95% CI +12.76 to +22.54 pp), p-value 0.0000. Decision: SHIP.

EXP-PRC-2025-06 (Upfront fee transparency on the offer screen): accepted 90.98% treatment vs 88.78% control, difference +2.20 pp (95% CI -1.93 to +6.32 pp), p-value 0.2974. Decision: INCONCLUSIVE - underpowered: needed 1,530 users per arm for a 3.0 pp MDE, had 410.

risks.text: Collection efficiency is off target: 93.9% (>= 95.0% -> off track).
Payment failure rate is off target: 10.3% (<= 8.0% -> off track).
CSAT is off target: 3.46 (>= 4.00 -> off track).

Festive-season credit dilution: First-loan FPD30 for loans disbursed in the Oct-Nov 2025 festive season vs Jun-Sep 2025: affiliate 4.49% vs 1.71%, paid social 5.42% vs 3.67%, partnerships 2.40% vs 3.25%.
Acquisition fraud exposure: Campaign CMP-202509-AFFNB (Affiliate Network B, Sep 2025): spend ₹5.56 L, 1,258 signups, 4 funded customers, cost per funded customer ₹1.39 L; flagged 'inefficient_spend'.

recommendations.text: Add pre-due-date reminders (three days and one day before the EMI date) and same-day retries for failed auto-debits.
Make autopay mandate set-up the default step at disbursal and schedule debit retries around salary-credit dates; autopay borrowers repay on time more often.
Attack the top ticket drivers (KYC issues, payment failures) with in-app self-serve fixes and a first-response SLA; CSAT is below target.
Shift paid budget from affiliate and paid social towards referral and employer partnerships, which return the most value per rupee of acquisition cost.
Add device and velocity rules for affiliate traffic and pay affiliates on funded, performing loans instead of signups.
